description: Visible attribute phrases extracted by the assistant from the cited references and checked against their descriptions. Union vocabulary is supplied to every image; no ground-truth class is used to select prompts. Only the four pilot species are covered.
review_scope: Assistant checked source support; not a claim of expert biological validation. Attributes may be absent, occluded or variable in an individual photo.
prompts: red or orange insect wing cases with black spots
a black insect pronotum with pale edges
pale markings on a black insect pronotum
reddish brown fur on an animal back
white fur on an animal underside
small red fruit on short stalks

species.name: Hippodamia variegata
species.description: The wing cases range from orange to red and carry a variable pattern of dark spots. The black pronotum has pale borders and pale markings.

species.name: Geosciurus inauris
species.description: This squirrel has a reddish-brown back, pale ventral fur, small ears and a conspicuous long pale tail. The reference uses the synonym Xerus inauris.

species.name: Elaeagnus angustifolia
species.description: Leaves are elongated and slender with a silver-toned lower surface. New twigs and the fruit also have a pale silvery appearance.

species.name: Coprosma rotundifolia
species.description: The paired, broadly rounded leaves have fine hairs and may show purple patches. Small red fruit can appear on short stalks; fruit color varies.
